You want to run projects. Not just work on them - actually own them, lead the team, build the client relationship, and put your name on the outcome.

Our Structures Practice is looking for a Structural Engineer with the technical chops and the people skills to do exactly that. If you've spent the last few years building your craft and you're ready to step into a project leadership role across commercial, multi-family, education, civic, or mixed-use work - let's talk.

Who We Are

Holmes US is an international structural engineering firm with offices up and down the West Coast and a home base that goes back over 65 years to New Zealand. We're part of the Holmes Group - 500+ people worldwide - which means you get the resources and technical depth of a global firm alongside the culture and relationships of a West Coast practice where people actually know each other.

Our Structures Practice takes on the kind of work that shapes how people experience their city: university buildings, multi-family housing, civic projects, commercial developments, and seismic retrofits of the buildings already standing. The variety is intentional - it keeps the work interesting and the skill set broad.

What You'll Actually Do

Lead structural engineering projects from concept through construction administration across commercial, multi-family, education, civic, or mixed-use building types
Own client relationships - managing scope, schedule, budget, and expectations with clarity and consistency
Develop technically rigorous structural solutions across concrete, steel, wood, and masonry
Direct, mentor, and develop a team of engineers and designers
Drive quality control and technical reviews on your projects
Contribute to business development through strong client relationships and repeat work
Collaborate across Holmes practice areas - and, when a project calls for it, across our international offices
4-8+ years of structural engineering experience in a consultancy setting

s.h: PE license required; SE license preferred or in active pursuit
s.t:
B.S. or M.S. in Civil / Structural Engineering
Seismic design experience - this is core to our practice, not a bonus
Demonstrated ability to manage projects and lead or mentor a team
Strong communication skills - you're as comfortable presenting to a client as you are reviewing calcs
Proficiency in ETABS, SAP2000, or RISA

Depending on your experience, this role will be placed at our Project Engineer or Senior Engineer level. What we're looking for in either case is someone ready to lead projects, not just contribute to them.

Why Holmes?

The breadth of our portfolio is a genuine advantage for your career. You're not going to spend five years on the same building type. You'll tackle seismic retrofits, new high-rises, school campuses, and mixed-use developments - often in the same year. That variety means you build a skill set that holds up over a long career.

We invest in our people seriously. Holmes University is our internal learning platform, giving you access to technical training and leadership development throughout your career. Senior engineers and principals here are genuinely available - mentorship isn't a line item in a brochure, it's how we actually operate. And when you need it, you have access to the technical depth of the Holmes network across New Zealand and Australia.

We also believe you follow your interests. There's a clear path to leadership and ownership at Holmes - and we'll be straight with you about what it looks like from where you're standing.

Work-Life Balance, and We Mean It

Our hybrid model is three days in the office - the rest is yours. We offer biannual profit share so you participate in the success you help create. And we've worked hard to build a culture where overtime is the exception, not the expectation. You'll do better work when you're not running on empty, and we structure the practice accordingly.

Diversity / Inclusion programs and initiatives

$87,000 - $141,000+ depending on experience level and location, plus biannual profit share bonus potential. Salary is commensurate with experience, skills, and office location.

Our Commitment

At Holmes, we believe in building teams as diverse as the communities we serve. We provide equal support and opportunities for all our people to thrive, grow, and develop. Dream big - we'll help you get there.

Basic Requirements: United States Citizenship: Non-citizens may only be appointed when it is not possible to recruit qualified citizens in accordance with VA Policy. English Language Proficiency: Psychologists must be proficient in spoken and written English in accordance with VA Handbook 5005, Part II, Chapter 3, section A, paragraph 3j.

Education: Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. For the purpose of meeting this requirement, the term "specialty area" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.

Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science.

CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.

Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology).

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a re-specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re-specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and The specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

NOTE: The applicant must provide an official transcript and/or certificate documenting the completion of the re-specialization program, which includes completion of an APA or CPA internship. OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature.

AND Internship: Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern.

OR VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96-151 (pre-1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement.

OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program.

Licensure: Hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

May qualify based on being covered by the Grandfathering Provision as described in the VA Qualification Standard for this occupation (only applicable to current VHA employees who are in this occupation and meet the criteria).

Le monde a changé - et les nombreuses règles aussi qu'il faut prendre en compte. Nos clients ont besoin de conseils rapides, techniquement solides et pratiques pour avancer dans leurs projets.

* Vous rejoindrez notre équipe dynamique de conseil fiscal et traiterez des projets de conseil fiscal dans un large éventail de domaines : fiscalité suisse et internationale des structures d'emploi transfrontalières et de la planification, incitations en actions, retraites, rulings, etc.

FEDERAL TIME-IN-GRADE (TIG) REQUIREMENT FOR GENERAL SCHEDULE (GS) POSITIONS: Merit promotion applicants must meet applicable time-in-grade requirements to be considered eligible. One year at the GS-12 level is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-13 level.

Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

As a member of our Sales Strategy and Operations team, you will have an integral role in driving the insights, operations, and strategy that enables Sales to run better, faster, and smarter. Sales Strategy and Operations is an excellent platform to learn how a business really runs.

Prior candidates that our leadership team has worked with have gone on to be VPs and COOs of companies. You will be joining the Sales Strategy and Operations team as a high impact contributor, gaining exposure to a wide variety of challenges, processes, and data that makes the engine of this Sales organization hum.

As an Associate on the team, you will lead cross-functional initiatives from ideation to analytics to recommendations to drive impact across the sales organization. Specifically, you’ll help the Data team connect with sales leaders about their top concerns, and help set the priorities for how the team tackles the problems that matter the most.

Additionally, you’ll run a cohesive communications plan and talk through the team’s roadmap with key leaders across the organization.

Manage key stakeholders across the organization : Because the data we manage is so critical for so many people, our team has many stakeholders. You’ll be responsible for working with them, collecting their feedback, and evangelizing the roadmap and priorities for the team.
Identify pain points : You’ll work with sales reps and leaders across the company to look at their workflows and identify where our team can provide value.
Promote the team’s roadmap : You’ll assemble decks, newsletters, and other comms to disclose the team’s priorities, roadmaps, and timelines.

Process Documentation: You iterate quickly to find a solution and then have the discipline to document your logic and workflows so they are reproducible and easy for others to understand.

Basic SQL and coding skills are a must: While you don’t need to be an expert, you need to understand the basic building blocks of how the team works.
Strong mastery of SQL and python-based analytics packages (e.g., pandas) are a huge plus.

High-impact self-starter: You take initiative to move projects forward and operate with high autonomy. You are excited by the challenge of "owning" the data layer of a cross-functional workstream in a fast-paced environment.
Analytical Rigor: You "nerd out" about data accuracy. You can quickly structure analyses to answer critical business questions and provide the data-driven evidence needed to influence company strategy.

## Where passion meets opportunity ##
The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!
## Your Purpose ##
MSC Cruise Management UK is seeking a driven Claims Manager to join our Legal and Insurance team. The role requires experience in the cruise or wider maritime industry, with a strong focus on personal injury claims handling and insurance-related matters.
The successful candidate will manage a range of shipping-related and complex personal injury claims with limited supervision, and act as a key liaison with internal stakeholders and external counterparts, including opposing counsel, P&I insurers, agencies, ship command and other departments, ensuring effective coordination and resolution of claims.

· Independently manages Admiralty matters, including coordination of legal response and case handling.
· Handles personal injury claims, ensuring timely assessment, documentation and resolution.
· Manages deviation claims, including analysis, coordination and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
· Coordinates legal strategy across claims and litigation matters, working closely with internal and external counsel.
· Oversees cross-departmental coordination and ensure effective flow of information across relevant business units.
· Manages external third parties, including correspondents, surveyors, experts and other service providers.
· Leads accident investigation processes, including evidence collection, preservation and case file preparation.
· Conducts settlement negotiations and support dispute resolution strategies, aiming for efficient and commercially sound outcomes.
· Liaises with external counterparties, including opposing counsel, P&I insurers, P&I correspondents, agents and medical or crew departments.
· Manages P&I insurance matters, including coordination of coverage issues, claims handling, and policy renewals for the fleet.
· Applies strong understanding of shipping agreements, crew employment contracts, Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs), ITF standards, PEME requirements and safety of life at sea regulations.
· Provides regular reporting to the Head of Claims on case status, trends, statistics, and potential exposure, including budget forecasting and claims reserves.
## Your Journey so far ##
· English as the primary working language; knowledge of a second language is considered an advantage.
· Maritime and/or legal studies.
· Previous exposure to the cruise or wider maritime industry.
· Knowledge and understanding of personal injury claims handling is required.
· Strong analytical and organisational skills with attention to detail.
· Ability to work in an international, fast-paced environment.
· Ability to work autonomously while also contributing effectively within a team environment.
· Strong communication skills and ability to liaise effectively with multiple stakeholders.
· Willingness and ability to travel when required.
## Your Essentials ##
· Eligible to work in the UK
## Our commitment ##
We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.
Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

We are looking for a consultant who thrives at the intersection of process design, cross-functional coordination, and customer outcomes. As Asana transitions from Collaborative Work Management (CWM) to AI Workflow Management (AWM), you will lead enterprise customers through that same transformation — helping them define what AI-powered work looks like for their organization, aligning stakeholders around a shared adoption plan, and driving measurable impact across their highest-value workflows.
You will design and lead structured, time-bound engagements — from onboarding through workflow launch — that move customers from seeing Asana as just a work management platform, to a platform where teams and agents execute work together.

This requires strong judgment, the ability to operate in ambiguity, and a consistent focus on connecting AI capabilities to business outcomes. You will regularly engage both executive stakeholders and front-line teams, adapting your approach to meet customers where they are and move them forward.

You will lead customers through structured engagements in partnership with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions, and R&D to drive valuable adoption of AI.
Account Setup and Implementation Planning
Lead a structured onboarding engagement — aligning customer stakeholders on platform setup, workflow priorities, and a shared definition of success, while assessing workflow complexity to identify where AI capabilities will deliver the strongest early impact.
Document and hand off a clear implementation plan — capturing recommended and prioritized workflows, known risks, and next steps so the activation phase can begin with full context and stakeholder alignment.
AI Activation & Customer Check-Ins
Lead end-to-end workflow design and build – guiding customers through deep discovery and process mapping, hands-on workflow configuration, and user acceptance testing to deliver production-ready workflows with AI capabilities embedded throughout.
Coordinate cross-functional delivery across a structured time-bound engagement – aligning workflow owners, IT and business stakeholders, and end users through kickoff, training, and launch while keeping the engagement on track against defined milestones.
Develop clear documentation and forward-looking deployment plan – capturing what was built, decisions made, and a prioritized roadmap that defines how the customer scales AI usage, including recommendations on what to optimize and where to expand next to continue driving broader adoption.
Lead recurring check-ins with customers – assessing workflow performance and AI adoption, surfacing pain points, and identifying where additional implementation support can unlock new workflows or use cases - alongside account teams.

Act as the connective tissue between delivery and growth - surface expansion signals during delivery, represent the voice of the customer internally, and partner with the account and R&D teams to translate customer momentum into growth.
Bring structure and repeatability to the delivery motion – define engagement processes, document decisions, and create repeatable frameworks that scale across a portfolio of customers to drive account momentum and program improvement.

Customer Experience: experience in customer-facing implementation or consulting roles, ideally leading structured onboarding or deployment engagements at a SaaS company or consulting firm. Experience deploying AI-powered workflows or enterprise AI tools is a strong plus.
AI & Platform Fluency: You have a solid understanding of AI and generative AI technologies — including AI workflow design, agent orchestration, enterprise AI platforms, and data governance. During an implementation, you can assess a customer's existing workflows and identify where AI creates a meaningful redesign of how work gets done — and configure the platform accordingly.
AI Change Management. You guide customers through the unique hurdles of adopting AI during an implementation – helping teams see how AI changes their day-to-day work for the better. You manage user adoption friction with empathy and patience, meeting people where they are at in their AI readiness and building confidence in the changes.
Complex Project Experience: You understand what it takes to implement a new platform successfully in an enterprise environment from discovery to adoption. You manage multiple workstreams and executive stakeholders, simultaneously, keep implementations on track, and hold both internal and customer teams accountable to milestones and timelines.
Customer-Centric: You're passionate about understanding customer needs and developing trusted relationships. You lead structured, engaging sessions, translate customer feedback into clear and actionable configuration decisions, setting customers up for a successful, lasting adoption.
Bias Toward Action: You thrive working through ambiguous situations, making sound decisions with incomplete information, iterating quickly, and not waiting for perfect conditions to move work forward. When ambiguity shows up in an implementation, you bring structure and momentum rather than hesitation.
Structured Solutions & Communication: You naturally create clarity where it doesn't exist — defining processes, documenting decisions, and adapting your message confidently across executive sponsors, workflow owners, and end users. You break down complex workflows into clear recommended future states that customers can act on.
Strong Cross-Functional Partner: You are skilled at proactively partnering across internal functions like customer success, sales, product and IT keeping stakeholders aligned and engagements on track. You understand that a smooth implementation depends as much on internal alignment as it does on customer execution.

# **Herzlich willkommen in der Medbase Zentrale Winterthur** #
Unser **modernes Bürogebäude** befindet sich nur drei Minuten vom Bahnhof Winterthur entfernt, in einer **urbanen Umgebung**, die ideale Voraussetzungen für konzentriertes Arbeiten und kreative Zusammenarbeit bietet.
In unserer Zentrale arbeiten rund **150 Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten** aus den Bereichen IT, HR, Marketing und Finanzen Hand in Hand, um gemeinsam **innovative Lösungen** zu entwickeln und unsere Unternehmensziele zu erreichen.
Mit **flexiblen Arbeitsplätzen** und modernen **Meeting Pods** fördern wir eine **offene und effiziente Arbeitskultur**. Bei Medbase legen wir grossen Wert auf **Teamarbeit** und den Austausch zwischen den Abteilungen, um gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.
Hier treffen sich Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unseren Schwesterunternehmen wie Zur Rose, WePractice oder dem Zahnarztzentrum, was den **interdisziplinären Austausch** weiter bereichert.
Viele Standorte. Ein gemeinsames Ziel. Deine Führung.
Du kennst den Schweizer Apothekenmarkt, denkst unternehmerisch und magst es zu gestalten und bewegen? Als Regionalleiter entwickelst du unsere Apotheken in der Region Winterthur/Ostschweiz wirtschaftlich, qualitativ und personell weiter. Du gestaltest die Zukunft der Standorte gemeinsam mit den Geschäftsführungen deiner Region, Du verbindest wirtschaftliche Verantwortung mit pharmazeutisch-medizinischer und kundenorientierter Qualität.
Das kannst du bei uns bewegen
* **Führung wirksam gestalten**: Du entwickelst Geschäftsführungen deiner Region weiter, stärkst ihre Führungskompetenz und leistest wichtige Beiträge für leistungsfähige Teams.
* **Unternehmerisch steuern**: Du verbindest wirtschaftliches Denken mit einem guten Gespür für die Situation vor Ort. Relevante Kennzahlen und identifizierte Hebel helfen dir dabei, Potenziale zu erkennen, die richtigen Prioritäten zu setzen und gemeinsam mit den Standorten nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
* **Apotheke und Kundenerlebnis weiterentwickeln**: Mit einem klaren Fokus auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden stärkst du Beratung und Service, entwickelst das pharmazeutisch-medizinische Angebot weiter und sorgst für attraktive, leistungsfähige Standorte. Gemeinsam mit den zentralen Fachbereichen sowie den Standorten bringst du strategische Initiativen erfolgreich in die Umsetzung.
* **Veränderung und Wachstum gestalten**: Du beobachtest das lokale Marktumfeld, erkennst Chancen und Entwicklungen frühzeitig und gestaltest Veränderungen aktiv. Dabei begleitest du die erfolgreiche Integration neuer Standorte und stellst sicher, dass neue Impulse nachhaltig an den Standorten und in deiner Region Wirkung entfalten.
Was du mitbringst
* **Aus- und Weiterbildung**: Du bringst eine höhere Aus- oder Weiterbildung in Betriebswirtschaft, Detailhandel, Gesundheitswesen, Pharmazie oder einer vergleichbaren Richtung mit.
* **Marktkenntnis**: Du kennst den Schweizer Apothekenmarkt sehr fundiert aus der Praxis und verstehst seine regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen sowie die relevanten wirtschaftlichen Hebel.
* **Führungskompetenz**: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung von dezentralen oder filialisierten Organisationen zeichnet dich aus. Führungskräfte entwickelst du klar, verbindlich und wertschätzend.
* **Retail- und Kundenverständnis**: Du verbindest fundierte Apothekenkenntnisse mit einem ausgeprägten Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse, Verkauf, Standortqualität, Warenpräsentation und einen effizienten Personaleinsatz
* **Unternehmerisches Denken**: Kennzahlen und betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge sowie Affinität zu Marketing und Verkauf sind für dich wichtige Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Daraus leitest du Prioritäten und konkrete Massnahmen ab.
* **Wirksam umsetzen:** Mit Entscheidungsstärke, Kommunikationsgeschick und Gestaltungswillen bringst du Themen sowie Teams voran und sorgst für eine nachhaltige Umsetzung.
* **Digital und nah vor Ort**: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, bewegst dich sicher in der digitalen Arbeitswelt und bist gerne regelmässig an den Standorten deiner Region präsent. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

We are seeking an experienced Civil & Interior Project professional to lead end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of projects with high end finishes. The role spans civil finishes works, interior works (joinery, finishes, MEP coordination), cost & schedule control, vendor management, and quality & safety compliance. The ideal candidate has hands-on site leadership, strong stakeholder communication, and demonstrable delivery of multi-site/commercial projects.

Project Planning & Coordination
Prepare and manage project plans, timelines, and work breakdown structures (WBS); track milestones.
Conduct feasibility, site readiness assessments, and method statements; plan sequencing of civil and interior activities.
Coordinate MEP interfaces with civil finishes (HVAC, electrical and lighting, plumbing fixtures, fire safety systems etc).
Drive design development and shop drawings review; ensure GFC (Good for Construction) drawing alignment.
Civil Works Execution
Oversee structural alterations, flooring, waterproofing, masonry, plastering, Flooring works (Granite/tiles/vinyl/epoxy etc), cladding (Granite/Marble/Wooden etc), painting; ensure compliance with IS codes and NBC India.
Interiors / Fit-Out Delivery
Supervise joinery, modular furniture, partitions (gypsum/glass), ceilings, wall treatments, veneers, laminates, stone, metal, and soft finishes.
Ensure sample approvals, mock-ups, material submittals, and finish schedules; maintain snag lists and close-out.
Coordinate with designers for detail resolution (profiles, skirtings, reveals, edge bands, hardware).
Vendor & Stakeholder Management
Manage subcontractors, supplier performance, and site workforce allocation; resolve site conflicts.
Liaise with client representatives, architects, and consultants; run weekly progress reviews.
Compliance, Safety & Documentation
Enforce EHS and site safety standards (PPE, method statements, tool box talks, risk assessments).
Ensure statutory approvals and municipality norms are adhered to.
Maintain daily logs, measurement books, RFI/RFP trackers, as-built drawings, and handover documentation.
Quality & Handover
Implement quality control plans and benchmarks; conduct mid-project and final inspections.
Drive commissioning (if applicable for MEP), snag rectification, and defects liability follow-up.
Education: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering (preferred), or Diploma with strong experience.
Experience: 10+ years in civil & interiors projects (commercial office, retail, hospitality, or high-end residential).

As a Construction Project Commissioning Manager, you will work on a team delivering a hyperscale data center. You will have direct accountability for project quality and commissioning.
This job is part of the Construction Management function. They are responsible for ensuring all deliverables of construction projects are completed on time. This job is part of the Project Management function. They are responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion.

This person is responsible for all Commissioning and Quality Control related projects at the site where they will be assigned. This will include but not be limited to expansions, modifications, retrofits and "new" technology driven projects!
Location: This role is on site in the Cedar Rapids, IA area. (relocation assistance available) This is a full time onsite position.

Provide Owner’s Representation (OR) and Project Management (PM) services.
Work with owner teams and design teams to manage all Quality and Commissioning reporting for delivery of projects.
Facilitate timely inspections by owner vendors and general contractor vendors to ensure project schedule is met.
Review vendor and general contractor Quality and Commissioning program plans to ensure conformance with owner standards and project specifications.
If required, assist with development of testing and inspection procedures in alignment with owner requirements and project specifications.
Facilitate regular meetings during the project, specifically during commissioning process, to ensure the design specifications are followed, to resolve conflicts, and facilitate construction.
Assist with management of project punch list development and closeout throughout the project.
Assist with RFI and submittal processing.

Prepare Project Status and Construction Risk Assessment report. Seek approval for the release of construction funds.
Review contract drawings, specifications, and opine for completeness and general compliance with best practices.
Coach others and share in-depth knowledge of your own job discipline and broad knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
Impact a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities within your own team and other related teams.

Bachelor's Degree preferred with 5-8 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
Commissioning and quality control experience on complex projects (hospitals and medical facilities, laboratories, large commercial buildings, high rise buildings, manufacturing facilities, or power plants and transformers) is required.

The successful candidate will serve as a Project Manager reporting to the Public Safety and Emergency Management Programs Unit. The Project Manager will manage a variety of projects encompassing application development, COTS, infrastructure, or a combination of each of these types of projects, in addition to providing senior level management support for the Project delivery team and support functions.

· Determine the project approach, resource requirements, team roles and responsibilities, and schedule
· Develop and review estimates and assumptions for the projects schedule, effort, and cost using established estimating models, best practices, and past experience
· Create project charter and scope statements, weekly status reports, risk and issues log and other project deliverables
· Manage projects throughout the entire assessment and development life-cycle, providing direction for project teams and monitoring the progress of deliverables and tasks;
· Create and manage project, risk mitigation, and communication plans
· Plan, track, communicate with, and drive infrastructure solution; build and support resources
· Work closely with executive level leadership, as well as internal and external stakeholders
· Provide oversight and management of blended teams of independent IT consultants and staff; manage vendor relationships, including participating in the creation of CPs, RFPs, review/selection of vendors, contracts, etc.
· Conduct site visits, when required, to ensure correct visual requirements are captured to effectively execute the project
· Manage receipt of project assets and ensure assets are correctly tagged in collaboration with PSEM SACM and technical teams
· Ensure that staff and consultants adhere to the published PMO methodology and development standards defined for the PMO
· Engage in PMO-related functions including monitoring budget and ensuring that established communication plans, risk management, and similar processes are adhered to
· Define team member roles and expectations and ensure that project resources are used effectively
· Participate in the review of project artifacts including technical requirements, user experience design, architecture, testing and implementation documentation
· Develop training plans and future support needs
· Manage project close out and transition of all project artifacts and knowledge to agency staff prior to disengaging from a project
· Identify future support needs and work with appropriate units to assist the agency with articulating and requesting these resources
· Support and contribute to the Program’s goal of ongoing process improvement, and adherence to Project Management Institute’s PMBOK and OTI published project methodologies
· Report to senior management within the Program, OTI and stakeholder agencies on project status
· Supervise and mentor Project Managers/Assistant Project Managers
· Support the Director of Project Management with managing PMO functions including: change requests, document and deliverable management, scheduling, reporting, etc
· Address client concerns and escalate all project issues appropriately and manage them to resolution
· Perform special projects and initiatives assigned.
Day - Due to the necessary technical duties of this position in a 24/7 operation, candidate may be required to work various shifts such as weekends and/or nights/evenings.
